reason: I already have a boutique near Hillcroft that knows me and my sizes, and between full-time shifts at the Medical Center I'm not driving out to Westheimer on a Sunday for 15% off. If I need something for Eid or a wedding, I go to my lady first.
objection: Westheimer is a drive from where I live, and my usual seller already gives me good prices and lets me pay over time. I don't know this store, so why switch?
would_change_my_mind: If a friend or my cousin showed me a thobe from there that was clearly better quality than what my shop carries, or if they had something specific I couldn't find for an upcoming wedding.
